correctness.rationale: For compact invariant μ, applying the generator to arbitrary smooth functions of z,y,x respectively gives E[1−4x|z]=0, E[x²−y|y]=0 and E[yz+h(x)|x]=0. Taking expectations yields E[x]=1/4, E[y]=E[x²]=1/16+Var x. Since zdot=−4(x−1/4), E[(zdot)²]=16Var x. Conditional L²-orthogonality of the residuals dot x and dot y yields the two variance Pythagoras identities, with correct signs. Equality forces x=1/4 μ-a.s.; the y residual identity then gives y=1/16, and support invariance forces z=−e−4f−16g; conversely its Dirac mass is invariant. Independent symbolic check verified equilibrium for arbitrary e,f,g. A finite symbolic identity does not replace invariant-measure arguments, which were reconstructed analytically.
